THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (RevisedEdition 1956) as amended by Acts. No. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 dated 04.04.2018 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 2066/7dated 09.04.2018 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour dated 23.03.2018.
Mr. H. K. Nimal, R.G. 4, Soyzapura, Moratuwa. of the one part
and
State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka, No. 130, W. A. D. Ramanayaka, Mawatha, Colombo 02. of the other part
was referred to Mr. Nandasena Bedigama for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade UnionRelations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 04.04.2018.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
30th July, 2018.Colombo.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Mr. H. K. Nimal, R.G. 4, Soyzapura, Moratuwa. of the one part
and
State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka, No. 130, W. A. D. Ramanayaka, Mawatha, Colombo 02. of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me bySection 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts,Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. ObadageLeelarathne, No. 242, Sri Sobitha Mawatha, Nagoda, Kalutara to be the Arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement byarbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
30th July 2018.Colombo.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. H. K. Nimal, R.G. 4, Soyzapura, Moratuwa. of the one part
and
State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka, No. 130, W. A. D. Ramayayaka, Mawatha, Colombo 02. of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether of Mr. H. K. Nimla who join the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanaka as a Computer Operator in 1981 and works as aSysterms Assistant at present had been caused injustice by not been given the post of systems Analyst/programmer and arrears of salary from1996 and the acting allowance for carrying out duties in the post of Data Entry Supervisor form 01.01.2006 and if so, to what reliefs he isentitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.Dated at the office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 25th day July 2018.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mrs.A.M.D.S Alahakoon, No.65/A, Jambugaswatta Mawatha, Palagama, Polgasowita. of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, No.234,Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Koswatta, Battaramulla. of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the disciplinary inquiry conducted against Mrs. A. M. D. S. Alahakoon who works as a Grade S II – Stenographer of the Sri LankaBureau of Foreign Employment based on the Charge Sheet dated 07.04.2015 and the amended Charge Sheet dated 14.01.2016 is correct andfair and whether the disciplinary order given after the inquiry is just and if not so, to what reliefs she is entitled.
